{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SELECT",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The user requested to implement the 'test_selection' pattern. However, the pattern description and the provided 'contraindications' (Strict contract requires the full test set) suggest that test selection can be risky if it hides failing tests. Since I must implement the pattern even if the benefit is uncertain, and the pattern mechanism involves comparing full and selected results, I will implement a version that uses 'git diff' to identify changed files and attempts to run only relevant tests. In this specific Node.js environment using 'ava', a common way to select tests is to pass specific file patterns to the test runner. I will add a step to detect changed files and pass them to 'npm test' if changes are detected, while ensuring the full test suite can still be run if needed. Note: Without a sophisticated dependency graph, this is a file-based selection heuristic.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: 'Test'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [24.x, 26.x]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Run Selected Tests
        run: |
          # Identify changed files in the current PR or last commit
          # If it's a PR, compare against the base branch. If push, compare against HEAD~1
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only origin/${{ github.base_ref }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep '\.js$' || true)
          else
            CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 ${{ github.sha }} | grep '\.js$' || true)
          fi

          if [ -n "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
            echo "Detected changes in: $CHANGED_FILES"
            # Attempt to run only tests related to changed files
            # Since 'npm test' runs 'npm run lint && ava', we pass the files to ava via npm test
            # Note: This assumes 'npm test' can accept arguments or we call ava directly
            # To preserve the original command structure, we use the files as arguments
            npm test -- $CHANGED_FILES
          else
            echo "No JS files changed, running full test suite"
            npm test
          fi
"
}
